data.title: Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill: Further Rate Hikes Expected in 2027 Beyond December
data.description: According to Jin10, the Financial Times reported that Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill said further rate increases may be needed in 2027, beyond the December hike. Pill said last week’s 25-basis-point increase to 4% was an important step toward a more appropriate monetary policy stance, but that there was still further to go. He cited the risk of second-round effects, with high energy costs feeding through to wages and businesses’ overall pricing, and said he expected evidence next year that would prompt further rate hikes. Pill said the Bank would take necessary measures to return inflation to its 2% target, adding that pressure to achieve it may now be greater. He said market expectations that the rate could approach 5% in 2027 were not unreasonable, and that the risks supported some of the rate increases priced in by markets, though he was reluctant to say whether they justified the full amount.

data.title: Nvidia Says Talk of New CEO Candidates Is Premature
data.description:
Nvidia said it is still selecting a firm to search for a successor to ousted leader Jensen Huang and has not begun talks with potential chief executive candidates, tamping down speculation about who will run the chipmaker, Bloomberg reported.

"We have not formally engaged with any potential candidates," Nvidia said in a statement. "Any speculation regarding individual candidates, whether internal or external, is premature."

The statement followed a Financial Times report that the board had approached Arm Holdings Chief Executive Officer Rene Haas about the job. Arm shares fell nearly 10% in New York on Friday before paring the losses.

Nvidia, the world's largest chipmaker, officially cut ties with Huang on Thursday over a widening scandal involving extramarital affairs and reports that he was targeted by a suspected Chinese spy. He ran the company for three decades and built it into the powerhouse at the centre of the AI computing boom.

data.title: Cursor Says Most Users Were Unaffected by Security Incident; Affected Users Notified
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Cursor said a two-week investigation found that an attacker obtained an access key it had issued to Fireworks, which was exposed by Fireworks. The attacker copied a limited amount of coding-agent trace data and used it to access some archived source code and support data through SaaS tools.

On October 29, the attacker used stolen credentials to place malicious copies of the Anthropic Claude Code extension, versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313, in the Cursor VS Code extension marketplace distribution cache. Up to about 5,000 users may have been affected; the versions were removed after about 11 hours. Cursor said most customers were unaffected and affected users had been notified directly. Data from users in Privacy Mode, production systems, official app updates, and customer code repositories were not affected.

Cursor said it rotated credentials, moved inference traffic, and rebuilt the extension marketplace. The company said it brought the incident under control on November 1.

data.title: Yes Bank Asks India's Top Court to Reconsider $893 Million Bond Ruling
data.description: Yes Bank Ltd. asked India's top court to review a ruling that revived 84.2 billion rupees ($893 million) of bonds written off during its 2020 rescue. The lender has said the decision could reduce a key capital ratio by about 2.5 percentage points, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Pickle Cat Sees U.S. Stocks Under Continued Pressure and Further ETH Downside Risk
data.description:
Trader Pickle Cat's Den said newly purchased ETH could still incur unrealized losses, and that a drop to $1,500 next year might be a relatively favorable outcome. According to Odaily, the trader said that over the past three months, avoiding futures trading and buying spot ETH through dollar-cost averaging had been the better choices.

Pickle Cat's Den said market pressures from the U.S. political and economic situation had not yet fully emerged, and it expects the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates in December and possibly continue hiking next year. The trader also said risks from an AI industry bubble and a decline in U.S. stocks had not been fully realized, and markets could face further corrections.

The trader said they had previously planned to buy ETH at $888 but now considered that price could no longer be an extreme low.

data.title: Binance Restores Withdrawals on 87 Networks, Targets Remaining Networks and Assets
data.description: Binance announced on X that it restored withdrawal services on 87 networks this week and aims to resume withdrawals for all remaining networks and assets before the end of next week.

data.title: South Korean Government Says GPU Supply Under Signed Contracts Will Be Unaffected by Jensen Huang’s Resignation
data.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation has raised concerns in South Korea’s AI industry about GPU supplies and AI infrastructure partnerships. According to Odaily, the South Korean government said supplies covered by existing contracts are expected to be unaffected by the management change; about 13,100 Nvidia B200 GPUs have been deployed, and plans to bring in next-generation GPUs, including Vera Rubin, are expected to proceed as scheduled.

Nvidia has partnerships with Naver, Hyundai Motor Group, SK Telecom and Kakao Mobility in areas including AI data centers, autonomous driving and robotics. Market observers believe existing contracts are unlikely to be affected in the short term, while the pace and priority of future investment, technical support and strategic cooperation will depend on decisions by Nvidia’s new management.

data.title: JackYi: Jensen Huang's Return and U.S. Stock Pessimism Cloud Short-Term Dip Buying
data.description:
Liquid Capital founder JackYi said cryptocurrency markets fell on Saturday amid the Jensen Huang event and expectations of a decline in U.S. stocks, adding that a further 30% drop in U.S. equities would not be unusual. According to Foresight News, he said investors should not rush to call a bottom while the situation remains unclear.

JackYi said that after Bitcoin pulled back from $86,000, he had identified $79,000, $75,000, and $71,000 as key levels and bought as the price moved above $77,000. He said Bitcoin’s structure suggested potential for a substantial rebound, but he took profits and sold most of his holdings as U.S. stocks plunged, keeping a small amount of spot Bitcoin.

He said the market’s direction now depends on U.S. stocks and that he is very pessimistic about Jensen Huang’s return and the outlook for equities. As a result, he is not optimistic about short-term dip buying.

data.title: Yi Lihua: No Short-Term Plans to Buy the Dip, Cautions Jensen Huang Event May Keep Pressuring U.S. Stocks
data.description:
Liquid Capital founder Yi Lihua said he is not considering buying the dip in the short term and cautioned that the Jensen Huang event may continue to pressure U.S. stocks. According to Odaily, he said the crypto market continued to fall on Saturday, mainly because of the event, and that expectations for the U.S. stock market had turned pessimistic. A further 30% decline in U.S. stocks was possible, he said, adding that it was too early to conclude the market had bottomed before the situation became clearer.

Yi said he had previously identified $79,000, $75,000 and $71,000 as key support levels for Bitcoin after its pullback from $86,000, and bought the dip near $77,000. At the time, Bitcoin’s own price action suggested significant potential for a rebound, he said. But after U.S. stocks plunged, he took profits and exited in time, retaining only a small spot position.

Yi said crypto market movements are now highly dependent on U.S. stocks. Given his pessimistic view of developments related to the Jensen Huang event and the outlook for U.S. equities, he plans to wait for the situation in the U.S. stock market to become clearer before considering buying the dip.

data.title: Tom Lee Signs Petition Supporting Jensen Huang as Signatures Top 30,000
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Bitmine Chairman Tom Lee said he signed the “Stand with Jensen” petition in support of Jensen Huang. The website lists more than 30,000 signatures, including 2,502 people identifying themselves as current Nvidia employees, 352 as former employees and 17,619 as shareholders. Signers provide their own identities, which the website does not verify.
